watches.name: Son Mài - Frosted Leaf « Storm »
watches.description: Inspired by rare and intense natural phenomena, paying tribute to Nature, in all its beauty and mightiness. 15 hours of work for each dial. A highly sophisticated, fully handmade process, consisting of a delicate “millefeuille”. Between each layer of pure lacquer, natural pigments and silver leaves are carefully dropped off. They are polished by hand to obtain the highest level of intensity and brightness, that no machines could ever reach.

It explores how colors, atmosphere and memories can be conveyed by the age-old Vietnamese art of Sơn Mài lacquerwork. We imagined a multi-layered dial, both literally and metaphorically. Like a track that gives itself away a bit more with every listening.

watches.name: Son Mài - Frosted Leaf « Union Jack »
watches.description: A limited edition of 50 pieces, crafted exclusively to honor the special relationship between AWAKE and the British market, this timepiece draws inspiration from the colors of the Union Jack, subtly reinterpreted through 15 hours of handcraft per dial — combining traditional Vietnamese Sơn Mài lacquer, natural pigments, and pure silver leaf gilding to create a deep, mysterious, and uniquely brilliant composition. For the first time, a figurative detail emerges from the organic textures: a miniature representation of the United Kingdom, meticulously hand-chiseled in silver leaf at the centre of the dial, discreet yet extraordinary, revealed only to those who take the time to look closely.

watches.name: Son Mài - Guilloché Main « Sunset »
watches.description: “Sunset”: Ocean Sunset The “Sunset” dial is distinguished by a rare and elegant “drapé-moiré” guilloché pattern, originating in the 1930s and recently rediscovered. Handcrafted in Italy on a straight-line engine, it evokes the rolling waves of the ocean through around one hundred precisely engraved grooves. This initial stage, requiring a refined artistic sensibility, is followed by a long and meticulous Son Mai lacquer process in Hanoi. Multiple layers of natural lacquer, enriched with pigments, are applied and polished to generate depth and transparency. Shades of pink, violet, and blue bring the guilloché pattern to life, forming a gradient inspired by a sunset. Of exceptional finesse and requiring nearly 15 hours of total work, this dial embodies the encounter of two crafts and cultures within a creation of remarkable richness.

watches.name: Son Mài - Guilloché Main « Borealis »
watches.description: “Borealis”: The Enchanting Northern Lights This version draws inspiration from the Northern Lights, expressed through a hand-guilloché “radiating” pattern of fluid, vibrant lines, crafted in Italy on a traditional engine. A true work of artistry, it demands subtlety, precision, and complete mastery of the gesture. The dial is then elevated in Vietnam through the application of multiple layers of pure lacquer, enriched with natural pigments, following an ancestral technique known as Son Mai. This meticulous ten-hour process creates a deep, richly textured motif, enhanced by nuanced gradients and unique material effects. In the light, the dial comes alive with shifting reflections reminiscent of the aurora borealis. This exceptional piece embodies the meeting of two cultures and crafts within a miniature creation of remarkable aesthetic richness.

watches.name: Son Mài - Guilloché Main « Alba »
watches.description: “Alba”: Incandescent Dawn The “ Alba” version draws inspiration from the energy of an incandescent sunrise, expressed through a Guilloché Main dial featuring a helical pattern, symbolizing momentum and vitality. Crafted in Italy on a traditional guilloché lathe, operated and guided by the artisan ’ s hand, this intricate motif - composed of around one hundred perfect grooves - requires a high level of precision and dexterity. Once guilloché, the dial is sent to Hanoi to be elevated through Sơn Mài lacquer, enriched with natural pigments and applied in multiple layers. This complete process, lasting approximately 15 hours, brings the dial ’ s unique patterns to life and enhances them with a deep gradient and vibrant reflections evoking the warmth of the rising sun. Balancing visual intensity with artisanal finesse, each piece embodies the meeting of two crafts and cultures in an exceptional miniature creation.

watches.description: The Atlantis Blue dial invites you to dive into the mysterious depths of the oceans and the myth of Atlantis, one of history’s most enduring legends. This model enriches the Sơn Mài - Silver Leaf collection, known for its smoky-gradient dials that draw the eye toward the center, echoing the iconic “Vignette” aesthetic of the 1970s and 1980s. Entirely handcrafted, this exclusive technique combines Vietnamese lacquer, pure silver leaf, and natural pigments layered with great precision to create subtle color transitions, remarkable depth, and a captivating visual intensity.

watches.name: Son Mài - Silver Leaf « Golden Hour »
watches.description: Inspired by the fleeting “golden hours” following sunrise or preceding sunset, this limited edition of 100 pieces is adorned with warm red, orange, and yellow hues. Like the Impressionists seeking to capture light, the artisans create a radiant ochre yellow center that fades into a vibrant orange and then covers itself in tobacco shades. By day, the dial shines like a solar flare; by night, it takes on the incandescent glow of embers. A poetic invitation to slow down and fully experience the present moment, even if it is fleeting.

watches.name: Son Mài - Silver Leaf « Ultra Violet »
watches.description: Provocative and captivating, this complex purple plays with light to accentuate its mystery. The vignette gradient obscures its edges, reinforcing its intensity and spiritual aura. Modern and assertive by day, it becomes intriguing and almost mystical in the dark. A bold watch, designed as a true style statement.

watches.name: Son Mài - Silver Leaf « Palladium »
watches.description: Elegant and subtle, this dial displays a gradient ranging from a luminous light gold to a deep brown. Both understated and refined, it symbolizes clarity and purity, while diffusing a warm and soothing atmosphere. A modern alternative to classic beige or brown tones, it combines discretion and sophistication, to match both a contemporary look and a vintage outfit.

watches.name: Son Mài - Silver Leaf « Carmine Red »
watches.description: Deep and provocative, carmine red has stood the test of time as a symbol of passion, courage, and seduction. Here, it appears in intense shades, from vibrant red to deep black, creating a powerful and stimulating dial. Its depth and reflections irresistibly attract the eye, infusing its wearer with energy and vitality.

watches.name: Son Mài - Silver Leaf « Moonlight Blue »
watches.description: Inspired by moonlight and the “blue hours”, this dial blends several blue pigments for a unique intensity. From airy light blue to mysterious midnight blue, it exudes a soothing energy and an almost meditative calm. Discreet yet rich in nuances, it embodies sobriety and elegance, while evoking the poetic transition between day and night.

watches.name: Son Mài - « Cotton Candy »
watches.description: « Cotton Candy » is a horological and artistic project, created to celebrate the 3rd anniversary of TickTockBelles, under the sign of softness and femininity. Inspired by the sweets of our childhood and the signature colors of their community - united by a shared passion for watches and things that last - « Cotton Candy » has been imagined with the sole aim of bringing pleasure, joy and sweetness to all TickTockBelles around the world.

specsRaw.Métier d’Art dial: Handcrafted using the ancestral Vietnamese technique of sanded lacquer "Sơn Mài" combined with cyan and pink exclusive colors made from natural pigments and inspired by the TickTockBelles color codes and the sweets of our childhood.

watches.name: Son Mài - "Year of the Sssnake"
watches.description: Produced in a very limited edition of 50 pieces, ‘Sơn Mài - Year of the Sssnake’ stands out for its aesthetic as impertinent as it is refined: a rock n' roll nod to the Year of the Snake, carried by an execution of the utmost precision. A rare watch, conceived as a manifesto of creative freedom.

specsRaw.Dimensions: 115x80mm / 20x16mm - Mounted on our 316L recycled steel pin buckle - fitted with presto pumps.

watches.name: Son Mài – Frosted Leaf - Moka
watches.description: Sơn Mài – Frosted Leaf « Moka » pays tribute to the Earth and its profound roots, with warm, comforting tones that embody authenticity and grounded strength. The multiple reflections of the silver leaf and lacquer, combined with the harmonious palette of different shades of brown used, confer a hypnotic brilliance and depth to this dial, as well as a certain elegance.

watches.name: Son Mài – Frosted Leaf - Green
watches.description: Sơn Mài – Frosted Leaf « Green » honors life, vegetal freshness, and balance, with organic textures that reconnect us to nurturing nature. Whether you perceive a forest, a mangrove or a canopy, the intensity of the pigments used, combined with the depth and relief of this dial, will have a soothing and revitalising effect, calling you to a greater connection with the nature that surrounds us.

watches.name: Son Mài – Frosted Leaf - Blue
watches.description: Sơn Mài – Frosted Leaf « Blue » evokes escape and infinity, with enigmatic shades of blue that recall water, sky, and vast open horizons. Featuring multiple shades of blue specially created by our master lacquerers, its dial is an invitation to evasion as much as to reflection and introspection, exuding a feeling of freshness and serenity.

watches.name: Jurassic Watch T-REX Edition
watches.description: The T-REX version features a gradient fire-orange dial, with its intense colour and striking reflections. Above the hour-marker at 6 o'clock, an applique representing 2 claw marks is subtly set, a nod to the fact that the T-Rex's forelimbs only had 2 sharp claws...

watches.description: The RAPTORS version features a dial in multiple shades of green, reminiscent of the eye of the film's most intelligent and devious creature: the Velociraptor. This time, 3 claw marks have been applied to the dial, reminiscent of those that adorned the forelegs of the ferocious predator.

watches.name: Son Mài – Collector set
watches.description: The first 10 pieces of the SƠN MÀI collection will be available exclusively as part of a luxurious collector’s set, numbered from 01 to 10. This collector’s set, adorned with an intense blue Vietnamese lacquer and finished to the highest standards, has been designed to offer even more pleasure and exclusivity to the most passionate among you! Each set contains all four versions of the SƠN MÀI collection, along with a collector’s fountain pen, specially developed for this occasion. Handcrafted in the same workshops, it showcases the two ancestral Métiers d’Art: Vietnamese lacquerwork (Sơn Mài) and pure silver leaf gilding. More than just an object, this pen carries deep symbolic value. It will accompany you through life’s most important moments, connecting you to the magic of craftsmanship and the essence of things made to last.

watches.name: Son Mài – Silver Leaf “Outre Bleu”
watches.description: This deep blue dial evokes tranquility, stability, and calm. Its hue, associated with well-being and spirituality, instills a sense of confidence and invites reflection and daydreaming. A favorite color in many Western countries, this shade—nicknamed Outre Bleu as a nod to Outre Noir by artist P. Soulages—exudes serenity and wisdom.

watches.name: Son Mài – Silver Leaf “Lava”
watches.description: This intense, powerful, and vibrant red dial offers warm reflections that awaken strong and dynamic emotions. A symbol of strength, energy, and passion, this vibrant red stimulates enthusiasm and will never go unnoticed.

watches.name: Son Mài – Silver Leaf “Emerald”
watches.description: This deep green dial stands out with its fresh and harmonious tones, offering a sense of calm and renewal. A symbol of life and prosperity, this color evokes nature and creates a soothing effect, perfect for balancing body and mind.

watches.name: Son Mài – Silver Leaf “Amethyst”
watches.description: This version is adorned with an intense, deep, and mysterious purple hue, often associated with precious objects and mystical concepts. Offering a sense of calm and sensuality, this color sits halfway between blue, symbolizing peace, and red, evoking passion and intensity.
